newsitem.title: FINLAND: Enso plans key staff stock options scheme.
newsitem.headline: Enso plans key staff stock options scheme.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Enso Oy said in a statement on Tuesday its board would propose to the April 7 annual general meeting a stock options scheme valued at up to 1.0 million markka for its top-20 executives.
Warrants linked to the five-year bonds with a 4.00 percent coupon would entitle to subscribe at most 3.0 million new Enso R-series shares, each with a nominal value of 10.00 markka.
Each 1,000 markka bond would carry one warrant which would entitle the holder to subscribe 3,000 Enso R-series shares. The subscription period would be December 1, 1998-March 31, 2004.

The subscription price would be 10 percent on top of the weighted average of Enso's R-series share on the Helsinki bourse during March 1997. The subscription price must not be below the average price of the share on the day before the annual general meeting, Enso said.
